original_ai_output.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚警告厄立特里亚：军队越境后将自卫
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 埃塞俄比亚指控厄立特里亚对北部提格雷地区发动"全面入侵"，并警告将进行自卫。埃塞俄比亚外长致信联合国安理会，称这是"公然侵略行为"。厄立特里亚方面则回应称其正面临邻国"无端的侵略战争"。据报埃塞俄比亚对提格雷境内的厄立特里亚部队发动了无人机打击。

key_facts.fact: 埃塞俄比亚指控厄立特里亚对北部提格雷地区发动"全面入侵"并警告将自卫
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ethiopia has accused Eritrea of an "all-out invasion" of its northern Tigray region and warned it will defend itself

key_facts.fact: 埃塞俄比亚外长致信联合国安理会，称此为"公然侵略行为"
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In a letter to the UN Security Council, Ethiopia's foreign minister called it a "blatant act of aggression that engages Ethiopia's inherent right to self-defence"

key_facts.fact: 厄立特里亚信息部长回应称其正面临邻国"无端的侵略战争"
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Eritrean Information Minister Yemane Gebremeskel responded by saying it was facing "an unprovoked war of aggression" from its neighbour

key_facts.fact: 埃塞俄比亚外长称厄立特里亚部队已深入提格雷多达60公里
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ethiopian Foreign Minister Gedion Timothewos said Eritrean forces had advanced up to 60km (37 miles) into Tigray

key_facts.fact: 据报埃塞俄比亚无人机打击了提格雷阿迪格拉特镇的厄立特里亚部队
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ethiopian drone strikes reportedly targeted Eritrean forces in the Tigrayan town of Adigrat on Wednesday and Thursday

key_facts.fact: 居民此前告诉BBC厄立特里亚部队已越境进入埃塞俄比亚
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: days after residents told the BBC Eritrean troops had crossed into the country

uncertainties: 厄立特里亚部队越境及无人机打击情况据报，尚未获独立证实
厄立特里亚是否支持提格雷人民解放阵线（TPLF）的说法存在冲突，厄方予以否认
目前仅一个来源（BBC）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
